t: Adds support for the login credential provider, allowing users to use AWS Management Console credentials for authentication.
Add support for a credential provider that handles resolving credentials via STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
Fixes an issue where credentials would be checked when creating an anonymous client. Fixes `#1472 <https://github.com/boto/botocore/issues/1472>`__
Disable proxy configuration when fetching container credentials
Add the ability to disable fetching credentials from EC2 metadata by setting the environment variable AWS_EC2_METADATA_DISABLED to 'true'.
Fix a race condition related to assuming a role for the first time (`#1405 <https://github.com/boto/botocore/pull/1405>`__)
Improved error message when the source profile for an assume role is misconfigured. Fixes aws/aws-cli`#2763 <https://github.com/aws/aws-cli/issues/2763>`__
Moved the JSONFileCache from the CLI into botocore so that it can be used without importing from the cli.
Fixed a bug causing issues in configuring the process provider on windows when paths were used.
Fixes an issue where cache keys would be too long to use as file names.
Fixes a bug causing cached credentials to break in the CLI on Windows. Fixes aws/aws-cli`#2978 <https://github.com/boto/botocore/issues/2978>`__
When creating an assume role profile, you can now specify a credential source outside of the config file using the `credential_source` key.
When creating an assume role profile, you can now specify another assume role profile as the source. This allows for chaining assume role calls.
Adds support for the process credential provider, allowing users to specify a process to call to get credentials.
Add support for environment variable credential expiration.
Add support for localhost when using container credential provider (`#1160 <https://github.com/boto/botocore/issues/1160>`__)
Raise error when partial hard coded creds are provided when creating a client.
Include timezone information when storing refresh time (`#869 <https://github.com/boto/botocore/issues/869>`__)
Fix race condition in credential provider.
